evidence.document: MaxLinear SPX5205 historical marking and package evidence

marking.appearance_status: R33 is a historical MaxLinear marking; the 2014 change notification lists replacement RCWW with production-dependent fields. Typeface, orientation, placement and date/lot details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative KiCad SOT-23-5 model vertically scaled from 1.55 mm to MaxLinear listed 1.45 mm package thickness. Catalogue source omits height; not a verified mechanical or PCB model.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
